lines.en: Small body. Light steps.

lines.zh: 我像一块会走路的石头。
lines.en: I'm a rock that walks.
Just one small crystal on me.
I hop along, little by little.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，里面在响。
lines.en: Something clicks inside as I move.

lines.zh: 我身上只有一小片晶体。
lines.en: There is only one small patch of crystal on me.

lines.zh: 我这么小，很容易被踩到。
lines.en: This small, easy to step on.
I shuffle along a stone seam.
Slow. My legs are too short.
I walk on, over small stones.

lines.zh: 我绕过同伴，它们比我还小。
lines.en: I go around my kin. They're smaller still.
Each step, my crystal flashes.
I stopped. My crystal blinks.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，不知道在看什么。
lines.en: Head up. Not sure what I'm looking at.
My light is weak.
I crouch by the originium, very small.
Listening. Very faint sounds.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有薄薄一片。
lines.en: My body's a thin shard.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，像打了个嗝。
lines.en: I twitched. Like a hiccup.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭地面，找舒服的姿势。
lines.en: I rub against the ground. Finding a spot.
Too bright here. I squint.

lines.zh: 我想不起来自己从哪来的。
lines.en: I can't recall where I came from.
You're huge. I look up.
I tilt my head. The crystal tilts.
Are you going to step on me? Don't.
I'm not scared. Really.
A heavy smell on you.

lines.zh: 我退了一小步，就一小步。
lines.en: One small step back. Just one.
Looking up like this hurts my neck.
Will you pick me up?

lines.zh: 我身上的光映在你靴子上。
lines.en: My light reflects on your boots.
I blink very slowly.
I nearly shattered. That hurt.
I rolled aside.
A crack on me.

lines.zh: 你打这么小的东西，不害臊？
lines.en: Hitting something this small. No shame?
The light on me dimmed.
I curl up until you're done.

lines.zh: 这一下，我好久才缓过来。
lines.en: That took a while to shake off.
No pain. Just can't move.
My kin gathered around.
The pain bends me double.
Is that something edible?
I smell ore.
I'm small. I don't eat much.
Put it down and I'll come.
That thing glows a little.
I hop twice, a little closer.
If you won't, I won't fight for it.
I can't bite hard things.
That smell makes me tingle inside.

lines.zh: 你低头看看我，我就在这儿。
lines.en: Look down. I'm right here.
You touched me. I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚开，又爬回来。
lines.en: I am knocked rolling, then crawl back.

lines.zh: 这么小，撞了也没感觉吧。
lines.en: This small. Did you even feel it.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶，硌得你手疼。
lines.en: The crystals on me sting your hands.
You missed me by a little.

lines.zh: 我的晶体碰到你的鞋，响了。
lines.en: My crystal clicked against your boot.
I crawled back again.
Don't push. I'm unsteady.
The ash is taller than me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边绕过去。
lines.en: I slip past your feet.

lines.zh: 我这么小，还考虑不了这些。
lines.en: This small. Can't consider that.
I don't even have a name.

lines.zh: 我们这种，都是矿里长出来的。
lines.en: We grow out of the vein.
Come close and I'll hop away.
I don't understand you.
Standing a bit apart is fine.
My crystal is still too small.
Don't touch me. I might break.
Plenty of my kin on this ground.

lines.zh: 我太小了，没工夫想这些。
lines.en: Too small to spare a thought for it.
I pick it up. Can't walk now.
I cannot lift it; I push it with my head.
I sniffed it. Stone.
I drag it behind me, slowly.
I can barely carry it.
Can't hold it. Dropped.
This shiny thing is mine now.

lines.zh: 我把它推到石缝最里面。
lines.en: I shove it deep into the crack.
Smells of ore. I don't eat it.
Can't lift it. Too heavy.
Something's coming.
I raised my crystal.
I'm small. I still stand up.

lines.zh: 源石在我体内长成了骨头。
lines.en: Originium grew into my bones.

lines.zh: 我跳了两下，往你脚边去。
lines.en: Two hops toward your feet.
Locked on. Not backing down.
This place is ours.
I'm glowing.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了石头，我看到了。
lines.en: You broke a stone. I saw.
I'm starting. Careful.

lines.zh: 我不高，但我的影子朝着你。
lines.en: I'm low, but my shadow points at you.
You stepped on me just now.
My crystal is very bright now.

lines.zh: 你看不到我，因为你太高了。
lines.en: You can't see me. Too tall.

lines.zh: 地上的小石子，都是我的同伴。
lines.en: The pebbles on the ground. All my kin.

lines.zh: 我要叫了，虽然声音很小。
lines.en: I'll call out. Quietly.
I close in, hop by hop.
You shift. I shift with you.

lines.zh: 我们有好几个，你只有一个。
lines.en: There are several of us. One of you.
Low to the ground. Hard to spot.

lines.zh: 我身上的源石，开始发亮。
lines.en: The originium on me starts to glow.
You're standing among my kin.
I counted. No way out.
Waiting in the stone seam.
A little further forward.
I jump. Now.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面往你的脚去。
lines.en: I go for your feet, low to the ground.

lines.zh: 你每退一步就踩一个我的同伴。
lines.en: Each step back, another of my kin.

lines.zh: 我不抬头，一直看着你的鞋。
lines.en: I don't look up. I watch your boots.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，这对我有利。
lines.en: You crouched. That favors me.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤过去，很快。
lines.en: I slip through the seam. Quick.

lines.zh: 我的晶体在地上留了光点。
lines.en: My crystal leaves dots of light.

lines.zh: 你听见那细碎的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear that faint clicking?

lines.zh: 你脚一抬起来，我就往前挪。
lines.en: When your foot lifts, I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 我这一小片，也够你疼一下。
lines.en: Even a shard like me can hurt.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子中心走。
lines.en: I walk in the middle of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我撞在你脚上，像小石头。
lines.en: I hit your foot like a pebble.

lines.zh: 这一下不太疼，但是真的。
lines.en: Not much pain, but it landed.
I rake you with the crystal edge.
I bounced off and came back.
You lifted a foot. I took the gap.
I'm small. I don't stop.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也翻倒了。
lines.en: That flipped me over too.
A little grit fell off me.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底被我刮了一下。
lines.en: I scraped your sole.
I pulled back for a breath.
I get into the gap in your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下，我把自己也撞裂了。
lines.en: That cracked me too.

lines.zh: 我从脚踝那里划了一下。
lines.en: A scrape across your ankle.
You kicked me. I flew.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，别小看小东西。
lines.en: I'm back. Don't dismiss the small.
This crystal edge is sharp.

lines.zh: 我整个身体撞你的小腿。
lines.en: My whole body into your shin.

lines.zh: 你退了，我追不上，只能等。
lines.en: You backed off. I can't follow. I wait.

lines.zh: 我自己都没料到这么重。
lines.en: Even I didn't expect that much weight.
I jump and hit your knee.
I come up out of the soil. Small.
A small patch of light appeared.
I was born with one crystal.
Ash covered me. I shook it off.

lines.zh: 我抬头看这个世界，好大。
lines.en: I look up at the world. So big.
There's something under this ground.
Two steps and I held.

lines.zh: 我从石堆里爬出来，很小。
lines.en: I crawl out of the rubble, tiny.
My light is weak. I can still see.
I open my eyes, slowly.
Nobody around notices me.
I'm tiny. Easy to miss.
Near fire, my crystal burns hot.
Hit the ground. A piece broke.
Water wraps me. I can't move.
The blast threw me a long way.
Something grazed me and I flipped.
That light whitened my crystal.
No ore. I'm darkening.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人弹起来。
lines.en: The lightning lands and I bounce off the ground.
Falling. I'm too small for this.
